content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: So because they consider it to be bad luck but not because something like a ghost or an alien is going to come out and eat them.
content.trans: 所以，因为它们认为这是倒霉的事情，但并不是因为像幽灵或外星生物出现并吃掉他们。

content.text: So listen, why don't you tell us what you think about ghosts?
content.trans: 英语：所以，听我说，你为什么不告诉我关于鬼的问题？

content.text: Are people superstitious in your country?
content.trans: 是的，你在你的国家里迷信人吗？

content.text: Did they believe in ghosts?
content.trans: 英语：Did they believe in ghosts?

content.text: Come to our website www.englishpod.com and let us know and we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 来我们的网站www.englishpod.com，告诉我们，我们会在这里见面的。

content.text: Well thanks for downloading and goodbye!
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文内容。
